limitations: Standalone primitive only: no llama.cpp graph integration, full-model logit gate or new Mistral tok/s result.
Actual quantized down weights with synthetic activations are not a general model-quality evaluation.
Native CPU quantized matmul differs numerically from dequantized FP32 reference; CPU equivalence remains unproved.
Small resident bank and sequential microbenchmarks are not full-model cache or throughput simulations.
GPU fused completion timings include launch/events/synchronization but not H2D upload or final error-flag copy.
GGML comparator timings have a different API boundary; device events and host-completion timings are separately retained.
CPU cache-pressure buffer is outside timing, not a direct measurement of DRAM cache residency.
Safety-instrumented runs are excluded from timing evidence.
No multiplied whole-model speed claim follows from primitive speed ratios.
